title.zh: 【俄罗斯财政部首次以数字卢布发放部分员工工资】
title.en: 【俄罗斯财政部首次以数字卢布发放部分员工工资】

current_state.zh: Russia's Finance Ministry made its first salary payments in digital rubles to some employees starting October 1, building on a 2025 budget-spending pilot of roughly 16 million digital rubles (~$192,000).
current_state.en: Russia's Finance Ministry made its first salary payments in digital rubles to some employees starting October 1, building on a 2025 budget-spending pilot of roughly 16 million digital rubles (~$192,000).
